summary_en: 1,000,000 shares (2.5% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥2.0B upper limit, ¥20,000 ceiling price per share, open-market acquisition via Tokyo Stock Exchange, 2026/07/28–2027/01/31. Rationale: fulfil DOE 3.5%+ target and progressive dividend policy within 7th medium-term plan (FY2025–2027); expand shareholder returns and maintain capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice regarding the Decision of Matters relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Yokogawa Bridge Holdings announced a treasury stock buyback program on 27 July 2026, approved by the board that day under Company Law Article 165(3). The company will acquire up to 1 million shares (2.5% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥2.0 billion at an upper price of ¥20,000 per share via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, with execution window 28 July 2026 to 31 January 2027. The buyback supports the company's 7th medium-term plan (FY2025–2027) shareholder return policy, which targets DOE of 3.5% or above and progressive dividend growth; the company stated it will continue dividend increases while conducting tactical treasury acquisitions to expand shareholder returns and maintain or improve capital efficiency. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 39,374,999 shares outstanding (excluding 3,789,803 treasury shares, of which 383,193 are held in the executive stock-grant trust).
